title: Kaleido Bloom
description: A guilloche rosette of fine engraved light. Music breathes and weaves the rings; on Source B, spreading both hands opens the bloom and raising them deepens the petals.

parameters.label: Weave
parameters.description: Phase offset that interlaces neighbouring rings.

parameters.label: Lace
parameters.description: Light racing along the engraved lines.

parameters.label: Pulse
parameters.description: A ring of light expanding on musical attacks.

parameters.label: Body Open
parameters.description: How much spreading the hands opens the rosette.

provenance.prompt_summary: A kaleidoscopic flower of layered petals: bass breathes the bloom, melody counter-rotates the layers, treble lights a fine lace and attacks send a bright ring outward.
